meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体自动部署应用到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让 agent 帮你把 Web 应用一键部署到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let agents deploy web apps to Vercel automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want agents to deploy web apps to Vercel with one click

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 Vercel 命令来部署 Web 应用，例如自动部署到生产环境、列出部署列表、检查身份等，无需手动输入令牌。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 将 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 平台时触发。

say.text: 把我的网站部署到 Vercel 上。
列出我当前所有的 Vercel 部署。
say.note: Claude 会执行 vercel ls 命令列出部署。

say.text: 检查 Vercel 认证状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run Vercel commands to deploy web applications, such as deploying to production, listing deployments, and checking authentication, without manual token entry.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to deploy a web application to the Vercel platform.

say_en.note: Claude runs vercel deploy --yes --prod to deploy.

say_en.text: List all my current Vercel deployments.
say_en.note: Claude runs `vercel ls` to list deployments.
Claude runs `vercel whoami` to verify token.
